name: SWaT Inlet Flow Rate (FIT101)
description: Volumetric flow rate into Stage 1 raw water tank via motorized valve MV101. When valve is open, flow should be consistent. Uncertainty from electromagnetic flowmeter noise and pressure fluctuations.

elements.name: Inlet Flow Rate
elements.description: Flow rate when MV101 is open. Should be approximately constant during normal inflow. Uncertainty from turbulence and electromagnetic flowmeter resolution (±0.5% of reading at nominal 1.2 m3/h).

uncertainty.source: SWaT dataset: FIT101 during normal open-valve operation. Published attack analyses show normal range approximately 0.8–1.55 m3/h. Electromagnetic flowmeter accuracy ±0.5% full scale.

elements.name: Minimum Required Inlet Flow
elements.description: Minimum flow to maintain RO production rate of ~19 L/min (1.14 m3/h target, 0.5 m3/h minimum safety margin)

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(FIT101) = FIT101 if FIT101 >= FIT101_min, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The minimum production flow guards the inlet flow rate uncertainty set; flow below 0.5 m³/h starves downstream RO stages.
